title: Validate the full declared cheat parameter domain
changes: Document the existing partial source-declared parameter command, guarded preview and preset choice preservation without claiming that local declarations verify game behavior.
Reject a declared parameter list or stepped range when any selectable value cannot fit every placeholder slot, before advertising that declaration as usable.
validation: Focused Linux tests passed for parameter substitution, catalog assessment, local-control compatibility, preset persistence and armed-set behavior. The width tests cover a list with an oversized later value, an oversized stepped-range endpoint and a range whose last reachable value fits.
The changed Windows GNU test target cross-compiled successfully; Windows tests were not executed.
limitations: The parameter command and preset path remain partial: the current catalog has no structured value domains, the menu has no value selector, and an isolated end-to-end flow and Windows execution are not yet verified. An attempted Wine validation did not start because automatic approval review hit its usage limit; no unsafe fallback was used.
